title: The lane-archive refusal names the add_repo act when it cannot read a lane's repo
why: lane-closes-after-records refused three times tonight on lane session-mailbox-followups because this session could not read the lane's second repo; add_repo fixed it at 09:08 CST. The owner asked (09:12 CST) that the fix be mechanical.
source: retrospective 09:13 CST Nov 13, owner ask 09:12 CST
note: Fix: when the archive guard cannot read a lane repo, its refusal names the act 'add_repo <owner>/<repo> (read), then retry', with the repo from the lane's cs-repo tag. Red first: a fixture lane whose repo read fails gets that remedy. The gap itself (archive-guard-child-repo-read) is a debt for the lane to file on main.
